item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - Iowa PBS - Rusalka by Des Moines Metro Opera [1080p] (2020)
item.description:
Hi all!

I came across this interesting production of the famous Rusalka opera by the Des Moines Metro Opera. Unfortunately, this proshot is (seemingly?) no longer available to steam anywhere.

I was wondering if anyone out there has it, 1080p preferably? It streamed in 2020 on PBS.org by the Iowa PBS network so I was hoping someone archived it. It does seem the video might be hidden on the official PBS page but disabled from public viewing, as this link asks for a PBS login password.

Any help would be great!
